description: This file defines the EditReminderDialog class, a UI component for creating and editing reminders in an Android app. It manages user interactions for setting reminder details such as date and time, handles permissions, and interacts with a ViewModel for data operations.

classes.name: EditReminderDialog
classes.description: A dialog class for editing or creating reminders, handling user input for reminder details, and managing notification permissions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes noteId and reminder from arguments.

methods.name: createBinding
methods.description: Creates and returns the view binding for the dialog.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up the dialog UI, initializes date/time formats, and handles notification permissions.

methods.name: setupListeners
methods.description: Configures click listeners for date and time pickers and save button.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Static method to instantiate the dialog with noteId and reminder.
